DESCRIPTION: This figure contains two vertically stacked line plots comparing training rewards over training steps for two methods across two difficulty levels. Both plots share the same x-axis structure, labeled "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks at intervals of 100. Both plots share the same y-axis label "Training Rewards" with a linear scale.

The top plot is titled "Easy Training Set" and has a y-axis ranging from approximately 0.0 to 0.4. It contains two lines: a blue line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." Both lines start near 0.05–0.10 at step 0 and show an overall increasing trend. The blue line rises to approximately 0.25–0.30 by around step 100 and then fluctuates, reaching roughly 0.33–0.35 by step 500. The red line follows a similar upward trajectory but generally tracks slightly above the blue line after approximately step 150, reaching around 0.38–0.42 by step 500. Both lines are shown with light shaded regions indicating variance or confidence intervals.

The bottom plot is titled "Hard Training Set" and has a y-axis ranging from approximately 0.0 to 0.2. It contains two lines: a blue line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." The blue line remains essentially flat near 0.0 across the entire range from step 0 to step 500, showing no meaningful increase. The red line also stays near 0.0 from step 0 to approximately step 150–200, after which it begins to increase, rising progressively to approximately 0.20 by step 500. Both lines include light shaded regions representing variance or confidence intervals, with the red line's shading becoming more visible as the reward increases.
